## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm smoke:dist` / `pnpm smoke:prod` when relevant

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal paths or runtime data added
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/FEATURES.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, task)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] Commits signed off with `git commit -s`
